blocks.html: Where to take your kids this Halloween

Fret not if you’ve ran out of festivity ideas for this coming spooky season, Robinsons Malls opens its doors on October 25, 2015 for a day of Ghosts and Ghouls. Don’t let the day of the undead be a lifeless one and take your kids out for some eerie fun. Join them in the Trick or Treat parade around the mall where treats are aplenty. Bond over funfair games and win thrilling prizes. Cool down, relax and let magicians serve the tricks at the open-for-all magic show. It’s going to be a frightfully fun day for kids and the kids at heart. Come in costume or come as you are—catch the Ghosts and Ghouls Party at the following Robinson Malls: Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robninsons Place Imus, Summit Ridge Promenade, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinons Town Mall Los Baños and Robinsons Place Lipa.
For complete details on Robinsons Malls’ Halloween event, visit www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls.
